body_definition: 正文从摘要结束后的下一页开始，到参考文献标题前一页结束；附录不计入正文。

internal_total_page_target.note: 这不是官方页数要求。Figure 总数确认后，向用户报告证据支撑的预计页数区间；用户可锁定具体总页数，或选择证据充分即可。禁止以空话、重复图表或版式膨胀满足页数。

policy: As of 2026-09-21, reviewed official materials state no body minimum, body maximum, or total-page maximum. Official page gates and historical role windows are disabled by default. After the numbered Figure count is locked, the user decides the complete physical-PDF length; no page choice permits padding.
